name: @workpulse/config
//: Deliberately no `exports` field, and the shim uses `.js` (not `.cjs`). ESLint 8's legacy config resolver goes through Node's default CJS resolver, which only probes `.js`, `.json`, and `.node` when the caller does not spell out an extension. A `.cjs` file at `<pkg>/eslint.cjs` therefore fails to satisfy `extends: '@workpulse/config/eslint'`. Revisit when we move to ESLint 9 flat config.
